items.raw_excerpt: The catalyst for the Malinauskas government's $45 million upgrade of the North Adelaide Golf Course has filed for bankruptcy. But the story could have been far worse.
items.summary_en: The company that sparked the Malinauskas government's $45 million upgrade of the North Adelaide Golf Course has filed for bankruptcy. The government also planned for the Australian Open, so the story could have been far worse.
items.summary_ko: 말리나우스카스 정부가 4500만 달러를 들여 추진한 노스애들레이드 골프장 개보수를 촉발한 업체가 파산 신청을 했다. 겉으로는 위험한 도박이었지만, 정부는 호주오픈 개최라는 대안도 함께 준비해 두어 상황은 훨씬 나쁘지 않았다.
items.title_en: SA Government Placed a Risky Bet on LIV Golf — Lucky It Had a Backup Plan
items.title_ko: SA 정부가 건 LIV 골프 도박, 보험 들어 둔 덕에 탈출
items.title_original: SA government backed a risky horse in LIV Golf — lucky it hedged its bets

items.raw_excerpt: Kirsty Pellant is calling for harm to reputation to be recognised as a distinct form of abuse.
items.summary_en: Kirsty Pellant says fake nude images of her spread online. She wants harm to reputation to be recognized as a separate form of abuse.
items.summary_ko: 커스티 펠런트는 자신을 성노동자로 보이게 한 가짜 이미지가 온라인에 퍼졌다고 말한다. 그녀는 명예 훼손이 별도의 학대 형태로 인정받길 원한다.
items.title_en: Deepfake images made her look like a sex worker
items.title_original: 'Deepfake images made me out to be a sex worker'

items.raw_excerpt: People on the estate in Drakes Broughton are refusing requests by the developer to let them through.
items.summary_en: People on an estate in Drakes Broughton are refusing a developer's requests to let its vehicles through. They parked their own cars to block the way. They say the developer is acting like a bully.
items.summary_ko: 드레이크스 브로턴의 주택 단지 주민들이 개발업체의 차량 통행 요청을 거부하고 있습니다. 주민들은 자기 차를 세워 길을 막고 있습니다. 개발업체가 억지를 부린다며 목소리를 높이고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Residents use own cars to block furious developer
items.title_ko: 주민들, 자기 차로 개발업체 진입 막아
items.title_original: Residents use own cars to block 'bully' developer

items.raw_excerpt: Rome's Baths of Trajan, an ancient bathing and leisure complex featuring giant frescoes and mosaics, is opening to visitors for the first time, the city's mayor said on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Rome's Baths of Trajan opens to visitors for the first time. The ancient complex has giant frescoes and mosaics. Visitors can now see its bathing rooms and open grounds.
items.summary_ko: 로마의 트라야누스 목욕탕이 처음으로 일반에 공개됩니다. 거대한 벽화와 모자이크로 유명한 고대 유적입니다. 방문객들은 고대의 목욕 시설과 넓은 뜰을 둘러볼 수 있게 됐습니다.
items.title_en: Ancient Roman bath complex opens to visitors for first time
items.title_ko: 2천 년 된 로마 목욕탕, 처음으로 공개
items.title_original: Massive ancient Roman bath complex opens to visitors

items.raw_excerpt: "Sarcophagus": that was the unexpected word Norway's King Harald V uttered to begin an October 2024 speech, joking about his final resting place - a $2 million sarcophagus whose design remains a secret.
items.summary_en: During a speech in October 2024, Norway's King Harald V joked about his final resting place. He said the design of his $2 million sarcophagus remains a secret.
items.summary_ko: 2024년 10월 연설에서 노르웨이 하랄 5세 국왕이 자신의 마지막 안식처에 대해 농담했습니다. 그가 만든 2백만 달러짜리 석관의 설계는 아직 비밀로 남아 있습니다.
items.title_en: Norway's King Harald V jokes about his secret $2 million sarcophagus

items.title_original: Norway’s King Harald V to be laid to rest in secret $2m sarcophagus

items.raw_excerpt: The Tomar City Council unanimously approved the final version of the regulation for the tourist tax of two euros per overnight stay, estimating to collect around 300,000 euros per year.
items.summary_en: The Tomar City Council approved a tourist tax of two euros per night. The city expects to collect about 300,000 euros every year.
items.summary_ko: 토마르 시의회가 숙박 1박당 2유로를 걷는 관광세 규정 최종안을 만장일치로 승인했습니다. 시는 매년 약 30만 유로의 수입을 기대하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Tomar Approves a New Tourist Tax

items.raw_excerpt: Σε ισχύ από τις 18 Σεπτεμβρίου νέες συγκοινωνιακές γραμμές
items.summary_en: Four big public transport changes start in East and West Attica on September 18. New bus and train lines will change how people get around. Commuters should check the new schedules.
items.summary_ko: 동부와 서부 아티카에서 9월 18일부터 네 가지 큰 대중교통 변화가 시작됩니다. 새 버스와 전철 노선이 생겨 주민들의 이동 방식이 바뀝니다. 출퇴근자는 새 시간표를 확인해야 합니다.
items.title_en: New public transport lines start in East and West Attica on September 18
items.title_ko: 9월 18일부터 동부·서부 아티카에 새 대중교통 노선 시작
items.title_original: Τέσσερις μεγάλες συγκοινωνιακές παρεμβάσεις σε Ανατολική και Δυτική Αττική

items.raw_excerpt: Karolina Pudlo from Poland is one of thousands of foreign-born voters ready to cast their ballot in Sweden's regional elections. She explains why she left the Moderate party over transitional rules for citizenship.
items.summary_en: Karolina Pudlo moved to Sweden from Poland and can vote in the regional elections. She left the Moderate party because of its rules on citizenship. She says the party made her feel betrayed.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드에서 스웨덴으로 이주한 카롤리나 푸들로는 지역선거에서 투표할 수 있는 수천 명의 국제 출신 유권자 중 한 명입니다. 그녀는 시민권 전환 규정을 이유로 온건당을 떠났다고 밝혔습니다. 당이 자신을 배신했다고 느꼈다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: A Polish voter in Sweden says the Moderates betrayed her
items.title_ko: 폴란드 출신 유권자, 스웨덴 지역선거를 두고 온건당에 배신감을 느껴
items.title_original: Voting in Sweden: 'I felt betrayed by the Moderates on transitional rules'

items.raw_excerpt: The public response to an April Fool's Day ad featuring a luxurious doghouse was so positive, the building company behind it went ahead and built one for real and is auctioning it off for charity.
items.summary_en: A building company showed a luxury doghouse as an April Fool's Day joke. People loved it so much that the company built a real one. It is now on auction to help animal charity.
items.summary_ko: 한 건설 회사가 만우절 농담으로 고급 개집을 선보였습니다. 사람들의 반응이 너무 좋아 실제로 개집을 만들었고, 이제 동물 보호 단체를 위해 경매에 올렸습니다.
items.title_en: April Fool's doghouse joke becomes real charity auction
items.title_ko: 만우절 농담이던 개집, 반응이 좋아 실제로 만들어 자선 경매에
items.title_original: SPCA to benefit from doghouse that evolved from April Fool's joke

items.raw_excerpt: Freight traffic on Dutch waterways slumped during the summer drought as low river levels forced barge operators to take lighter loads. Figures from the national statistics agency CBS show the amount of cargo taken by water was down by 19% in August compared to the previous year. In the entire month 21.8 million tonnes were transported, the lowest level in August for 15 years. The average load per vessel was 1300 tonnes, the same as during the last drought in...
items.summary_en: A summer drought lowered river levels in the Netherlands. Barge operators had to carry lighter loads, so freight traffic dropped by 19% in August. That was the lowest August level for waterway cargo in 15 years.
items.summary_ko: 여름 가뭄으로 네덜란드 강의 수위가 낮아져 바지선이 가벼운 짐을 실어야 했습니다. 그 결과 8월 수로 화물 운송량이 지난해 같은 달보다 19% 줄었습니다. 15년 만에 가장 낮은 8월 실적입니다.
items.title_en: Dutch waterway freight at lowest level in 15 years
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 수로 화물 운송, 15년 만에 최저
items.title_original: Freight carried by waterways drops to lowest level in 15 years

items.raw_excerpt: Category A COE premiums closed at S$133,009, up S$4,508 from the last bidding exercise.
items.summary_en: Singapore's car ownership certificates hit a new price record. Small car premiums closed at S$133,009, up S$4,508 from the last bidding round. The COE lets a person own and drive a car for ten years.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르에서 차량 소유 자격 증서(COE) 가격이 또 최고치를 갈아치웠다. 소형차 등급 낙찰가는 13만3천9달러에 마감돼 지난 입찰보다 4천508달러 올랐다. COE가 있으면 10년 동안 차를 소유하고 운전할 수 있다.
items.title_en: Category A COE premiums set new record, rising to over S$133,000
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 차량 면허권(COE) 또 신기록, 13만3천 달러 넘어
items.title_original: Category A COE premiums set new record, rising to over S$133,000

items.raw_excerpt: A brumby advocate has said in court that the pest management plan for a NSW national park does not give the government the right to conduct aerial culls.
items.summary_en: An advocate told the court that the pest plan for a NSW national park does not allow the government to cull brumbies from the air. The court decision could come down to the meaning of one word.
items.summary_ko: 한 야생마 보호 단체 관계자가 법정에서 뉴사우스웨일스 국립공원의 해충 관리 계획이 정부에 공중 포살 권한을 주지 않는다고 말했다. 판결은 계획서 속 한 단어의 해석에 달려 있을 수 있다.
items.title_en: Wild horse culling in NSW park rests on one word
items.title_ko: 뉴사우스웨일스 국립공원 야생마 공중 포살, 법정 판단에
items.title_original: Future of culling brumbies in NSW national park could hinge on one word

items.raw_excerpt: A 26-home development in Victoria Village has been given the go-ahead after a planning appeal against the original refusal was upheld.
items.summary_en: A 26-home housing plan in Victoria Village was first refused. Now a planning appeal has upheld the rejection, which lets the project go ahead.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아 빌리지의 26채 주택 개발 계획은 처음에 거부됐습니다. 이후 항소로 원래 거부 결정이 뒤집혀 진행이 허용됐습니다.
items.title_en: Appeal clears 26-home development in Victoria Village
items.title_ko: 빅토리아 빌리지 26채 주택 개발, 항소로 승인
